about_the_game:
You wake up on the tenth floor of an abandoned hotel.

Your head hurts—someone has attacked you, and now you’re trapped. You have no idea why this happened, but one thing is clear: you must escape.

But the hotel is not just any abandoned building. It’s a maze of dark corridors, locked doors, and unexpected dangers. The way out is full of obstacles—and worst of all? You’re not alone.

Game Features:

Exploration and Puzzle Solving – Search for keys, hidden objects, and clues to progress through locked rooms and hallways.

Survival Against a Killer – A mysterious enemy roams the halls looking for you. You must be careful, hide, and use your environment to survive.

Intense Horror Atmosphere – Dynamic lighting, disturbing sounds, and a terrifying environment create a constant tension that will keep you on edge.

Diverse Escape Routes – Choose from various ways to escape the hotel. Will you take the long, safer route, or risk a shorter but more dangerous route?

A Mysterious and Shocking Story – Discover secret letters, and clues scattered throughout the hotel that will help you understand the hotel’s and the killer’s dark past—and your connection to it.

A Random and Unpredictable Experience – Every time you play, the experience will be different. The hallways, rooms, and keys are randomly placed, making each escape attempt challenging and surprising.
